scripts.test: bun run test:frontend && bun run test:rust
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.build:extension: vite build --config vite.extension.config.ts && vite build --config vite.overlay.config.ts && cp extension/content.js extension/background.js extension/manifest.json 'safari-extension/Local Arena Clipper/Local Arena Clipper Extension/Resources/' && cp -r extension/dist 'safari-extension/Local Arena Clipper/Local Arena Clipper Extension/Resources/dist' && cp extension/lib/* 'safari-extension/Local Arena Clipper/Local Arena Clipper Extension/Resources/lib/'
scripts.pack:extension: bun run build:extension && rm -f build/mine-clipper.zip && mkdir -p build && cd extension && zip -r ../build/mine-clipper.zip manifest.json background.js content.js dist/ lib/ icons/ -x '*.DS_Store'
